name: Batisoke Soke Cimento Sanayii T.A.S.
summary: Batisöke Söke Çimento Sanayii T.A.S. produces and sells cement and clinker products in Turkey. Its products include Portland cement clinker and Portland cement, as well as aggregates. BATISÖKE Söke Çimento Sanayii T.A.S. was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Izmir, Turkey.
